training: Distinct second fit. Use only original V1 training forms after all prior exclusions plus new V2 training forms. Fit independent linear lexical heads for opening and pending modes. Pending features separate general dialogue wording from the presence/order of slot tokens. No old holdout, new challenge labels, external cases or student outputs in fitting.
evaluation: The new challenge contains eight entirely withheld original language forms per act (80 distinct forms), each with deterministic independent slot draws. Promote only if both row-weighted and form-balanced accepted precision and coverage clear the unchanged per-mode thresholds. Report negative-class decisions and abstentions separately. No threshold adjustments or post-test retraining.
